title: Gear
intro: Keep track of your shoes and bikes, see how far you have used them, and get a reminder when it is time to replace them.

empty.title: No gear yet
empty.body: Add shoes or a bike, then make it the default for running, walking or cycling.

defaults.title: Default per sport
defaults.hint: New workouts of this sport use your pick automatically. Workouts you already have do not change.

edit.name: Name
edit.startDistanceHint: Distance done before you added it to JoyoFit.
edit.retireAtHint: Leave empty for no limit. Running shoes usually last 500 to 800 km.

photo.error: The photo could not be loaded: {{error}}

edit.numberInvalid: Enter a valid number of kilometres.
edit.deleteBody: Workouts that used it stay, but are no longer linked to this gear.

reminder.near: Your {{what}} has done {{km}} km, close to the {{limit}} km limit.
reminder.reached: Your {{what}} has done {{km}} km, past the {{limit}} km limit. Time to replace it?

workout.title: Gear
workout.noMatch: No gear fits this sport yet.

strava.title: Strava
strava.empty: There are no {{kind}} on your Strava account. Add them on strava.com, Settings, Gear first: Strava does not let apps create gear.
strava.error: Strava gear could not be loaded: {{error}}
strava.notConnected: Connect Strava first in More, Strava.
strava.otherNoLink: Gear of type Other has no counterpart on Strava.
strava.note: After a workout is sent, JoyoFit puts this gear on its Strava activity.

gearAccess.title: Strava gear
gearAccess.off: To link gear, JoyoFit needs permission to read your Strava profile. Your shoes and bikes are only read to show them here and are not shared.
gearAccess.on: Permission to read gear is granted.
